definitions.decode_batch_size: number of decode requests scheduled in the iteration
definitions.grain: one scheduler iteration; measured and simulated series keep their own iteration ids

iteration_cycle_ms.last_iteration: null because no next boundary exists
iteration_cycle_ms.measured: first kernel start of this NSYS iteration to first kernel start of the next valid iteration
iteration_cycle_ms.simulated: this actual top-level iter cost_log wall_start_ms to the next; includes gpu_time_multiplier, tick quantization, and any scheduler gap

definitions.plot_axis: recorded iteration_id on each side; ids are not renumbered or paired
definitions.prefill_tokens: number of prompt/chunk tokens scheduled in the iteration
definitions.scheduled_kv_tokens: sum(decode request KV lengths) + sum(prefill prefix_len + append_len) for the iteration
definitions.scheduled_not_resident: scheduled_kv_tokens is the attention/KV workload touched by this iteration, not logical or physical resident KV-cache occupancy

time_axis.measured: first kernel launch of an NSYS iteration minus the first captured iteration's first kernel launch
time_axis.simulated: top-level iter cost_log wall_start_ms minus the first simulated iteration's wall_start_ms; this includes simulator gpu_time_multiplier effects
